reviews.comment: Brilliant chemist, but *not* an effective lecture prof. Read completely off the slides, which contain text/figures copied from Wikipedia and the textbook. The material is somewhat interesting, but you'll do most of the learning on your own. Easy 'A' if you use his study guides.
Interesting class I guess but he isn't a very effective teacher. He just pastes essays from wikipedia on his slides and calls it good. Midterm, Final, Project, and Paper are all the assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr Gladysz's Honors Ochem is difficult, there's no denying that. Exams are tough and regularly ask you to think beyond the problems covered in lecture. Grades will look pretty bad in there in terms of percentage, but he curves heavily based on overall class performance. Dr Gladysz is very smart, but be ready for a challenge if you take his class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I took the honors section of o chem which is the only one he teaches. He's a really great prof and teaches many strategies to approach problems which is helpful. However, the course is already difficult and his exams are insane! Fortunately he curves the entire class. You definitely do have to work for your grade but that's the same for any section
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Tests are tough
